stem: Sentence 26 does not effectively open the last paragraph (sentences 26–28). Which of the following can replace sentence 26 and help strengthen the concluding paragraph of this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Dealing with people when you are a teen offline will help you in a handful of critical ways.

options.label: B
options.text: Offline networking is important because it can improve a teenager’s well-being and help prepare him for the future.

options.label: C
options.text: Both online and offline relationships are important in today’s world of instant communication.

options.label: D
options.text: Every teen will need to practice offline communication so they can get used to talking with others.
